description: Returns an UNSIGNED Base transaction (and an ERC-20 approval transaction if needed) that performs the swap with the 1% CoinFactory fee embedded. The taker wallet must sign and broadcast it; CoinFactory never submits transactions. Swaps INTO critical-risk tokens are refused; high-risk tokens require acknowledgeRisk: true after relaying the risk signals to the user. Per-trade cap during beta: $1000. Non-custodial: CoinFactory returns aggregator calldata only and never holds funds or keys; the taker wallet signs and broadcasts. A 1% CoinFactory fee plus aggregator fees and gas apply and are shown in the quote. Trades are irreversible. This is not financial advice.

acknowledgeRisk.description: Required true when the buy token is rated high risk

sellAmount.description: Amount of sellToken in human units, e.g. '0.5'

sellToken.description: 'ETH', a Base contract address, a symbol, or a CoinGecko id

taker.description: The wallet address that will sign — must hold the sellToken
